generate_junit_xml: generate a JUnit XML file from test output logs in a directory
readtests_parse_joblog: parse a parallel joblog file and read stdout and stderr for each test
genxml_create_testsuites: create a JUnit testsuites XML document from a list of test result dictionaries
run_make_test_output: run the script with a test output directory path to produce JUnit XML
review_readtests_genxml: review the readtests and genxml functions for parsing job logs and generating XML
